name: Grafana
description: Plugin catalog has real OpenPGP-signed manifest + per-file SHA-256, but the verifying key is fetched unpinned from grafana.com by default (only A-equiv if an operator disables dynamic key retrieval). Core self-update notify-only.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The core updater fetches only a version JSON and sets a notification flag; it does not download or execute Grafana binaries.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

trust_root: key fetched from grafana.com by default
